blocks.text: The CIPA Compliance Report is an interactive report that provides information on the top URL categories that are blocked from the Legal Liability class, and the top users and domains blocked from accessing obscene or harmful material. To learn more, see Understanding CIPA Compliance.
To display the CIPA Compliance Report within Interactive Reports, you must have CIPA Compliance enabled within Advanced Policy Settings. To learn more, see Configuring Advanced URL Policy Settings.

This report cannot be copied. You are only able to see data for this report up to the last 7 days, so when scheduling the report, the Monthly option is grayed out. To learn more, see Scheduling Reports.
The report contains the following interactive widgets:

blocks.item: Top URL Categories Blocked from Legal Liability
Top Users Blocked from Adult Materials
Top Users Blocked from Weapons & Bombs
Top Users Blocked from Military, Hate & Extremism
Top Users Blocked from Illegal or Questionable
Top Users Blocked from Newly Registered and Observed Domains

blocks.text: To learn more about what you can do within the report, see About Interactive Reports.
